title: 8 Kitchen Cabinet Paint Colors on One Kitchen, Navy to Alabaster
description: One kitchen, eight Sherwin-Williams cabinet colors from Alabaster to Iron Ore, with codes, hex values and light reflectance, plus three picks for the finishing touches.
dek: Same kitchen, same light, eight cabinet colors. Compare them first, then pick the small upgrades that fit.
hook: A paint chip is hard to judge on a full run of cabinets. This guide shows one kitchen with shaker cabinets in eight Sherwin-Williams colors, so you can compare how each one reads next to the same tile, butcher block and brass.

The images are AI-generated concept pictures, not photos of a real kitchen. The code, hex value and light reflectance for each color come from Sherwin-Williams' own color pages, read Oct 25 and Nov 12, 2026. Screens change color, and the closest match on a screen is never the paint itself, so test a sample on your own cabinet door before you buy a gallon.
gallery_intro: Light reflectance (LRV) runs from 0 to 100. Lower numbers mean a darker color. Five of the eight are dark on purpose, since dark cabinets are the look most people ask about. Dark colors tend to show dust and fingerprints. Light colors tend to show grease near the stove.
gallery_note: AI-generated concept images of one kitchen. Colors are on-screen approximations of the paint listed under each look, so test a sample on your cabinets. They are not photos of a real kitchen.

picks.name: MCGOR 14.7" Rechargeable Motion Sensor Under Cabinet Lights, 2-Pack
picks.alt: Illustration of rechargeable under cabinet strip lights
picks.best_for: Seeing your new cabinet color at night
picks.limit: Check how the adhesive holds on your finish
picks.why: USB rechargeable strip lights with a motion sensor, 14.7 inches each, with no wiring. Light from under the uppers changes how every color in the gallery reads on the counter and lower cabinets after dark.
picks.con: They stick on, so how well they hold depends on your cabinet finish. Check the listing for the adhesive notes before you commit.

picks.name: Self-Adhesive Edge Fingerpull Door Handle (2-Pack, No-Drill)
picks.alt: Illustration of adhesive edge fingerpull cabinet handles
picks.best_for: Trying new pulls on painted cabinets without drilling
picks.limit: Check the weight and surface notes
picks.why: Matte black fingerpull handles that stick on without drilling. A quick way to test a new look next to a new cabinet color, and useful in a rental.
picks.con: Paint needs time to cure before anything sticks to it, so check the paint can for its cure time. Check the weight and surface notes on the listing.

picks.name: Housolution Expandable Cabinet & Pantry Organizer Rack
picks.alt: Illustration of an expandable wire cabinet organizer rack
picks.best_for: Emptying and resetting cabinets before painting day
picks.why: An expandable wire rack that keeps plates, trays and pans upright. Cabinets get emptied for painting anyway, so it is a good moment to reset what goes back in.
picks.con: Measure the shelf before ordering, since the rack expands to fit within a range. It does not help with the paint itself.

final: If you buy one, make it the under-cabinet lights. Lighting changes how every color in the gallery reads at night, and it works with any cabinet color. Add the pulls to test a new look once the paint has cured, and the organizer for the day the doors come off.
skipped: Paint, primer and cleaner sold by the can, since color and prep depend on your own sample test and the maker's directions.
